critical_code_review_comments: AppShell.jsx (line 376–394): enterprise upsell pill is rendered inside `{(() => { … })()}` IIFE with `mt-auto px-5 pt-8`, which means when the pill is hidden the parent block still adds the spacer + Administration label correctly. Logic is sound. No change.

InboundEmailPanel.jsx: handles loading / err / `data && !data.configured` / data states cleanly. Defensively renders the context address only when `data.context_address` is truthy. Toast on copy success/failure is correct. Minor: clipboard fallback for non-secure contexts (older browsers) is absent — acceptable since the app is always served over HTTPS.

Enterprise.jsx (line 33–39): GET /enterprise/interest/me on mount sets submitted=true if any prior submission exists. Because iter51 seeded a TEST_iter51 lead, the form is hidden for Bramuel forever once submitted (no edit / re-submit affordance). Acceptable for lead-gen MVP, but if the product wants to allow updating a lead, surface an 'Update my note' affordance in the thanks state.

Prepare.jsx MinutesTab (line 525–578): per-row toggle key uses `m.id` and stores in local `open[m.id]`; conditional rendering `{meta && isOpen && <MinutesExtractDetail/>}` correctly gates the detail block. Extract button disabled while busy is wired to `busy === m.id`. No issues.

AppShell.jsx trust badge: uses `var(--accent)` for Internal, default muted body colour for Secure/Confidential, `opacity-40` separators. Computed colours verified live: rgb(139,46,43) for Internal, rgb(111,106,93) for the rest — matches design intent.
